title: hedyotis beddomei
intro: Hedyotis beddomei, commonly known as the "Beddome's Hedyotis", is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and fighting against infections. The bioactive constituents present in Hedyotis beddomei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
